scientific.integrity: The fixed-hyperparameter AdEMAMix first-moment mixer is analyzed as two stable scalar EMA filters. The slow-to-fast magnitude ratio is differentiated exactly, giving a unique crossover law, and the constant-magnitude endpoint signals make the Adam-style denominator exact.
limitations: Fixed hyperparameters after source warmup schedules have settled.
Intermediate-frequency result concerns first-moment channel dominance rather than the complete adaptive update.
No nonlinear, stochastic-convergence, or generalization claim.

title: Exact frequency crossover for AdEMAMix's fast-slow momentum mixer
